report_level_evaluation.participants: n: 20; background: Graduate computer-science students with relational-database knowledge but no faceted-search/SemanticWeb/Sewelis experience
report_level_evaluation.tasks: 20min tutorial plus10min free training;18 genealogical questions across7 categories, including paths, disjunction, negation, inverse relations and cycles
report_level_evaluation.measures: Correct queries, correct answers, per-question time, SUS item responses and open feedback
report_level_evaluation.results: All20 produced correct queries for at least11/18 questions;19/20 answered more than half correctly;half answered at least15/18 correctly;mean test time40min(range21–58). Each question had at least50% success.; limits: 79-person test dataset and technical-student sample; no direct comparison with another system; ordered tasks/training support learning effects; query-focus errors affected answers. No aggregate SUS score is reported.; Safeness excludes some focus changes; do not claim every possible interaction prevents empty results.; LISQL translation selects one focus variable and omits OPTIONAL/named graph patterns in this report.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Not reported: comparator. 79-person test dataset and technical-student sample; no direct comparison with another system; ordered tasks/training support learning effects; query-focus errors affected answers. No aggregate SUS score is reported.; Safeness excludes some focus changes; do not claim every possible interaction prevents empty results.; LISQL translation selects one focus variable and omits OPTIONAL/named graph patterns in this report.
